entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a VeloBand Pulse monitor and it's... it's just not working. I don't know what to do.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I think it's a technical fault? It won't sync with my phone at all. I've tried everything in the little booklet. I think the device is just broken.
Okay, I see. And just to confirm, you're saying the band itself seems defective because it's failing to sync with the VeloFit app?
Yes, exactly. I'm just so confused by all this. I'm not very good with technology. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just return it.
Of course, I can certainly look into the return options for you. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your full name and email address?
Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem?

Not at all. I'm just checking our policy here. It states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh! You can? That's such a relief. I was so worried it would be a big hassle.

No hassle at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending you an email with a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That was so much easier than I thought it would be.
You are very welcome, Maria. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
